title: Learning with Limited Antigenic Labels: Semi-supervised Prediction of Influenza A Antigenic Relationships with Protein Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2512.05222v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Influenza A viruses (IAVs) undergo frequent antigenic changes that require regular vaccine updates. Because haemagglutination inhibition (HI) assays are labour-intensive, antigenic measurements remain limited relative to the available sequence data. We combined pre-trained protein representations with semi-supervised learning (SSL) to predict antigenic relationships when labelled data are scarce. HA1 sequences from H1N1, H3N2, H5N1, and H9N2 were encoded using ESM-2, ProtVec, ProtT5, and ProtBert. Using these embeddings, we compared self-training and label spreading with supervised baselines, including random forest (RF) and support vector machine (SVM) models. Nested cross-validation evaluated performance with 25%, 50%, 75%, or 100% of training labels retained. translated_title: 有限抗原标签下的学习：基于蛋白质语言模型的甲型流感抗原关系半监督预测
translated_abstract: 甲型流感病毒（IAVs）经历频繁的抗原性变化，需要定期更新疫苗。由于血凝抑制（HI）实验是劳动密集型的，相对于可获得的序列数据，抗原性测量数据仍然有限。我们结合预训练蛋白质表征与半监督学习（SSL），在标记数据稀缺的情况下预测抗原关系。来自H1N1、H3N2、H5N1和H9N2的HA1序列使用ESM-2、ProtVec、ProtT5和ProtBert进行编码。基于这些嵌入，我们将自训练和标签传播与监督基线方法进行比较，包括随机森林（RF）和支持向量机（SVM）模型。嵌套交叉验证评估了在保留25%、50%、75%或100%训练标签时的性能。自训练在大多数设置中略微提高了RF的性能，但通常降低了SVM区分抗原相似与抗原不同病毒对的能力……
tldr: 该论文的创新在于将预训练蛋白质语言模型表征（如ESM-2、ProtT5等）与半监督学习方法（自训练和标签传播）相结合，在标记数据稀缺的条件下预测甲型流感病毒的抗原关系，为减少昂贵的血凝抑制实验需求提供了新途径。
en_tdlr: This paper innovatively combines pre-trained protein language model representations (e.g., ESM-2, ProtT5) with semi-supervised learning methods (self-training and label spreading) to predict influenza A antigenic relationships when labeled data is scarce, offering a new approach to reduce the need for labor-intensive hemagglutination inhibition assays.
